analysis.title: Paul Donovan's daily audio: Slowdown silver-linings?
key_insights: Some Asian equity markets weakened again, but US futures point to stability. UBS sees no evidence that this reflects broader concern about the macro outlook.
A slowdown in AI investment may free physical resources for other parts of the economy. A new factory may produce an economic return more quickly than a new data center.

PMI polls are expected to get a 'not now, PMI polls' reaction from markets. Outlooks are driven by larger external shocks that individual purchasing managers cannot predict, and survey data quality is a general issue.

NY Fed President Williams speaks and policy views will be sought. Some Fed officials appear to be moving toward advocating a recession in the non-oil economy, for example by suggesting restrictive policy may be desirable.

Trump posted a photo with Putin captioned 'my friend'. It is not news to markets, but may damage far-right leaders in Europe and the UK who face pro-Ukraine electorates, and defense procurement shifts may accelerate over trust questions.
risk_factors: Larger external shocks drive the economic outlook beyond what PMI surveys can capture.
Some Fed officials may favor restrictive policy that induces a non-oil economy recession.
Further weakness in Asian equities could spread if concern about the macro outlook emerges.
geopolitical: Trump posted a photograph with Russian President Putin captioned 'my friend'. Far-right leaders in Europe and the UK that praised Trump face pro-Ukraine electorates, and defense procurement shifts may accelerate over questions of trust.
